sections.heading: Thiruvananthapuram's Process Industry: Titanium, Latex and Life Sciences
paragraphs: Thiruvananthapuram is known for Technopark and government, but it has three process industries that buy stainless tube, and they are very different from one another. The oldest is Travancore Titanium Products, incorporated on 18 December 1946 in collaboration with British Titan Products of the UK at the instance of the Maharaja of Travancore, which started production in 1952 at just 5 tonnes a year, expanded in 1962 and 1973, and now makes about 20,000 tonnes of titanium dioxide a year by the sulphate route, digesting ilmenite from the beach sands near Kollam in sulphuric acid.

The second is HLL Lifecare, set up in 1966 in Thiruvananthapuram and described by Wikipedia as the world's largest condom producer, maker of the Moods brand, with factories at Peroorkada and Akkulam in the city among its sites. The third is the newest: the Bio 360 Life Sciences Park at Thonnakkal on National Highway 66, 22 km from the city, where Phase I covers 75 acres and a further 128.5 acres is being developed as Phase II by the Government of Kerala. The park houses the Institute of Advanced Virology, set up by the Kerala Biotechnology Commission, and the Bioscience Research and Training Centre of the Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, and Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute plans a biomedical equipment unit there. Digital Health News reported in November 2025 that Kerala is moving ahead with a Rs 3,500 crore Genome City at the park, modelled on Hyderabad's Genome Valley, on about 60 acres and projected at around 15,000 jobs across pharmaceuticals, medical technology and biotechnology, while KSIDC and Sree Chitra are building the Rs 256 crore MedSpark medical-devices hub alongside it.

sections.heading: Where Electropolished Tube Fits in Each Thiruvananthapuram Plant
paragraphs: At a sulphate-route titanium dioxide plant most piping is rubber-lined, plastic or alloy, and electropolished stainless has one job: the small-bore lines that carry acid samples to analysers, impulse lines to transmitters, and reagent dosing. Here the grade matters more than the finish: 904L, which we supply electropolished, resists dilute and moderate sulphuric acid and ferrous sulphate liquor far better than 316L, and the passive electropolished bore keeps the sample representative.

A latex and medical-device plant is the opposite case: the finish matters as much as the grade. Latex compounding and dipping lines, the purified water used to wash and leach finished products, and the clean utilities to the packing hall are hygienic services where SF4 electropolished 316L, to ASME BPE surface designations, keeps biofilm and particle shedding down and lets cleaning be verified. A life-sciences park plant, whether a vaccine or biologics developer, a diagnostics maker or a biomedical device unit, is a pharmaceutical plant in all but name, and specifies SF4 316L on WFI and purified water loops, buffer and media transfer, product lines and CIP return.

sections.heading: SF1, SF4 and 904L on a Thiruvananthapuram Line List
paragraphs: Following ASME BPE surface designations, SF4 is a mechanically polished bore that is then electropolished, and SF1 is mechanically polished only. SF4 316L belongs on purified water and WFI, product contact, latex and biologics process lines, clean gas to cleanrooms and the CIP return leg. SF1 304L or 316L is sufficient for chilled water, plant air, hot water sets and transfer lines that are cleaned but not validated. 904L electropolished is for the acid and chloride-bearing lines of the titanium plant and for any aggressive cleaning or process chemistry elsewhere.

Coastal Thiruvananthapuram adds a corrosion factor. Salt-laden air attacks 304L on outdoor pipe racks, so 316L is the sensible starting grade for any exposed stainless run, and the chromium-rich passive film left by electropolishing resists pitting better than a mechanically polished surface. Tube and pipe are available to ASTM A270, A269, A249 and A312 in grades 304, 304L, 316 and 316L, with 904L electropolished on request.

sections.heading: Documents for a Thiruvananthapuram Regulated Plant
paragraphs: A device maker, a vaccine developer or a public-sector chemical plant each keeps a supplier file, and ours fits all three. Each heat ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number and chemical analysis by a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, so a 316L tube cannot be installed where 904L was specified, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report, all issued under a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015.

If your validation master plan, inspection test plan or public-sector tender calls for additional tests, third-party witness or a specific marking scheme, include it with the enquiry so the quotation covers it.

sections.heading: Sending a Thiruvananthapuram RFQ
paragraphs: A complete enquiry gets a quotation within 24 hours. For plants at Kochuveli, Peroorkada, Akkulam or the Bio 360 park at Thonnakkal, please include:
bullets: The plant and the system: acid sample or dosing line, latex or device process line, purified water or WFI loop, biologics process or CIP, clean gas, or utilities, and whether you are the plant, an EPC contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for product contact, water loops and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for utilities; 904L electropolished for sulphuric acid and chloride service.
Sizes: outside diameter, wall thickness, length and quantity for each line, the governing standard (A270, A269, A249 or A312) and the fittings or point-of-use connections they must match.
Validation or tender documentation required, and the delivery point in Thiruvananthapuram district.

paragraphs: Tube for Thiruvananthapuram is dispatched from our Mumbai base at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004, with every length capped and marked by heat number. The quotation states the dispatch date and transit to your site in writing.
